import pandas as pd

# Load the time_series_data.csv dataset
df_time_series = pd.read_csv('/data/time_series_data.csv')

# Identify the 'Depot' column and the 'CE' column
depot_data = df_time_series[['CE', 'Depot']]

# Drop rows with missing values in the 'Depot' column
depot_data = depot_data.dropna()

# Determine the century with the highest Depot values
depot_data['Century'] = (depot_data['CE'] // 100) * 100
century_peak = depot_data.groupby('Century')['Depot'].mean().idxmax()

# Verify the peak values for the identified century
peak_century_data = depot_data[depot_data['Century'] == century_peak]
peak_century_data.head()

# Check neighboring centuries for comparison
neighboring_centuries = [century_peak - 100, century_peak + 100]
neighboring_data = depot_data[depot_data['Century'].isin(neighboring_centuries)]
neighboring_data.groupby('Century')['Depot'].mean()
